name: VectorDB_Migration_Agent
description: Universal Vector DB Migration Agent: benchmark-gated, retrieval-preserving migration between vector databases (Pinecone <-> Qdrant in this build).

triggers.name: migration_id
triggers.description: Unique id for this migration run — also the checkpoint/resume key.

triggers.name: source_provider
triggers.description: Source vector database provider. Type exactly: pinecone, qdrant, milvus, chroma, weaviate, faiss, or vespa

triggers.name: source_resource
triggers.description: Source index/collection name. For vespa: '<namespace>/<document-type>' (Vespa has no simple index name). For faiss: any placeholder value works — the real identity is source_endpoint_ref's file path.

triggers.name: source_credential_ref
triggers.description: Your real API key/token, pasted directly (works immediately, no setup): PINECONE_API_KEY, QDRANT_API_KEY, MILVUS_TOKEN (Zilliz Cloud), CHROMA_API_KEY (Chroma Cloud), or WEAVIATE_API_KEY. Also accepts an environment variable name if the worker already has one set. Self-hosted milvus/chroma/weaviate without auth, and faiss (no server/credentials at all), still require a value here but it's ignored — pass any placeholder.

triggers.name: source_endpoint_ref
triggers.description: Endpoint/host — a literal URL, 'memory' for a local Qdrant/Chroma/Weaviate instance, or an environment variable name if the worker already has one set. For milvus: cluster URI (e.g. https://in03-xxxx....cloud.zilliz.com). For chroma: 'cloud://<tenant>/<database>' for Chroma Cloud, 'path://<dir>' for local persistent. For weaviate: cluster URL (Weaviate Cloud) or host:port. For faiss: REQUIRED — local filesystem path to the .faiss index file. For vespa: REQUIRED — the base URL of the Vespa endpoint.

triggers.name: target_provider
triggers.description: Target vector database provider. Type exactly: pinecone, qdrant, milvus, chroma, weaviate, faiss, or vespa

triggers.name: target_resource
triggers.description: Target index/collection name. For vespa: '<namespace>/<document-type>' (Vespa has no simple index name). For faiss: any placeholder value works — the real identity is target_endpoint_ref's file path.

triggers.name: target_credential_ref
triggers.description: Your real target provider API key/token, pasted directly (works immediately, no setup). Also accepts an environment variable name if the worker already has one set. See source_credential_ref for per-provider env var names and the faiss/self-hosted-without-auth placeholder note.

triggers.name: target_endpoint_ref
triggers.description: Endpoint/host for the target provider — see source_endpoint_ref for the per-provider format. REQUIRED for faiss (local index file path) and vespa (base URL).

triggers.name: id_collision_policy
triggers.description: What to do when a source id already exists in the target. Type exactly: fail, overwrite, skip, rename, or prefix

triggers.name: resume
triggers.description: Resume a previously terminated run with the same migration_id from its last checkpointed state.
